answer: No. Your records show lisinopril 10 mg was stopped on September 22, 2025 because it gave you a dry cough, and Dr. Marsh switched you to losartan 50 mg daily. By December 2025 the cough had resolved. Nothing in your records after that restarts lisinopril. The app is most likely showing an old entry, and the oldest copy in your records, from early 2025, still lists it as active. Lisinopril is also on your list as a drug that caused you a side effect (cough), so it's worth asking the app to remove it. Please don't restart it unless Dr. Marsh tells you to. Separately, your records disagree about hydrochlorothiazide: a March 2026 hospital stay for low sodium stopped it, but your clinic and your own May 2026 list still show it as active. Your sodium was still slightly low (134) in June 2026. I'd ask Dr. Marsh to confirm whether you should be taking it.
